title: Regulation of Imports and Exports (Amendment) Bill
what_it_is: Regulation of Imports and Exports (Amendment) Bill

sections.label: UNSC cargo inspection powers
sections.summary: The RIEA implements UNSC-mandated controls, and the Bill extends enforcement powers to goods in transit to meet Singapore's UN obligations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: The RIEA also implements all controls on the movement of goods mandated under the resolutions of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: As a responsible member of the United Nations, Singapore is legally bound by the UN Charter to implement the decisions of the UN Security Council for the maintenance of international peace and security.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Resolution 2270 mandates all UN Member States to inspect certain cargo, for example, cargo originating from or destined for the DPRK, that are within or transiting through their territories.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: The DPRK's development of nuclear and ballistic missile programmes poses a grave threat to international peace and security.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: It is in clear violation of the UNSC Resolutions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: This Bill presented today would extend the application of such enforcement powers to goods in transit, to meet our obligations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: An authorised officer may now exercise such enforcement powers where goods on board a vessel or aircraft are in transit and there is a requirement to inspect such goods pursuant to any written law giving effect to any relevant decision of the UNSC.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Goods are in transit if they are brought into Singapore for the purpose of being taken out of Singapore, on the same conveyance on which they were brought in.

sections.label: Bill fulfils UN obligations
sections.summary: The proposed Bill will allow Singapore to carry out its UN obligations and safeguard regional and international security.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: To conclude, the proposed Bill will allow us to carry out our UN obligations and demonstrate Singapore's resolve as a responsible global citizen to do its part to safeguard regional and international security.
